newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for New Year.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for New Year.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur tin market is closed on Wednesday for the New Year holidays. The market reopens on January 2.
On Tuesday, Malaysia's tin price ended the last trading session of the year 25 cents higher at 14.85 ringgit ($5.88) a kg due to covering mainly by European buyers, traders said.
Final turnover was 201 tonnes, up from 72 tonnes on Monday.
The local price premium over the LME widened to $270 a tonne against $200 previously, the traders said.
